Hi everyone my name is Edward and I help homeless animals!
Now I live in Georgia, the city of Batumi.
Unfortunately there are a huge number of homeless cats and dogs here.
Animals are sick, injured and have poor nutrition.
I and other volunteers are trying to help animals, we catch them, we spay them, if the animal can live with a family of people then we try to find a home, if the animal is completely feral then after recovery and vaccination we let it go to live on.
Subscribe, it will be very interesting!
